'''Gevil Flan''' owned a warehouse on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fait d'Fait]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] agent and racer [[Siro Simito]] used Flan's warehouse when stopping over on Fait d'Fait. He was aware of Simito's identity and the fact that he should be racing rather than conducting business on-planet but did not betray Simito due to his family connections as a member of the [[Vallaido Clan|Vallaido pirate clan]].
